intro: Texts about education bring together levels, subjects, titles and requirements; identify who is studying, which programme they are on and what they need.

frases.estudio: Для участия в программе требуется диплом университета.
frases.alumno: To take part in the programme, a university degree is required.

frases.estudio: После окончания курса студент получил сертификат.
frases.alumno: On completing the course, the student received a certificate.

piezas.titulo: Texts about education bring together levels, subjects, titles and requirements; identify who is studying, which programme they are on and what they need.
texto: Texts about education bring together levels, subjects, titles and requirements; identify who is studying, which programme they are on and what they need.
Distinguish обучение (the teaching or training process), учёба (studying) and образование (education or training).

pregunta.texto: What does a диплом usually certify?

opciones.explicacion: Диплом is a document that certifies a qualification.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Для участия в программе требуется диплом университета.»

frase.texto: Для участия в программе требуется диплом университета.

opciones.texto: To take part in the programme, a university degree is required.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: On completing the course, the student received a certificate.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: После окончания курса студент получил сертификат
